title: Health response advertises AI status but never populates it

evidence.quote:
Returns basic health information including version, uptime,
    and AI provider status.

return HealthResponse(
        status="healthy",
        version=__version__,
        uptime_seconds=uptime,
        last_successful_digest=last_digest,
        ai_provider=settings.ai_provider,
        ai_model=settings.get_llm_model_string(),
    )

reasoning: The response model and handler documentation expose an AI status contract, but the route never sets ai_status, so clients receive null instead of a real provider health value. The imported LLMService has a health_check method in the codebase, which makes this look like incomplete endpoint behavior rather than an intentionally absent field.
reproduction: GET /api/health and observe that ai_status is null even though the response schema includes it and the handler says it returns AI provider status.
recommendation: Either call the LLM health check and map its status into ai_status, or remove/rename the field and documentation so the public response contract only promises provider and model metadata.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: tests/test_health.py only asserts status, version, and ai_provider; it never asserts ai_status is present with a meaningful value or intentionally omitted.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend test_health to assert the intended ai_status behavior, using a mocked LLMService.health_check if the endpoint should report live provider status.
